mostWorthwhile.text: Building the water-resistant surface was most worthwhile because it showed how cells and fats work together to slow water loss without stopping it completely.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two named structures into their matching slots was clear but a little repetitive.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the skin barrier reduces water loss rather than preventing it entirely.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and slot names made the connections understandable.
